name: helping-hand
title: Helping Hand
description: Transform text with saved prompts using Claude, Codex, Raycast AI, Ollama or Apple Intelligence
author: jay_pancholi

commands.name: transform-text
commands.title: Helping Hand
commands.description: Pick a prompt, transform text with Claude, Codex, Raycast AI, Ollama or Apple Intelligence

preferences.name: defaultProvider
preferences.title: Default Provider
preferences.description: Provider selected when Helping Hand opens (falls back to the first ready one)

preferences.name: claudeModel
preferences.title: Claude Model
preferences.description: Model alias or ID passed to claude --model

preferences.name: codexModel
preferences.title: Codex Model
preferences.description: Model passed to codex exec -m (blank uses Codex default)

preferences.name: ollamaModel
preferences.title: Ollama Model
preferences.description: Model passed to Ollama (pull it first with ollama pull)

scripts.build: bun run build:swift && ray build -e dist
